label: Corporate Wellness
heroHeading: A wellness room staff actually use
seoDescription: Executive wellness rooms & employee recovery programs. Commercial-grade HBOT, sauna & cold therapy with measurable ROI.

valueProps.title: Short sessions that fit a workday
valueProps.body: Ten minutes of red light or a few minutes of cold fits a lunch break. A sauna suits the end of the day.

valueProps.title: One supplier for all four
valueProps.body: Hyperbaric, cold, heat and light from the same manufacturer. One contract, one install team, one app and one number to call when something needs attention.

valueProps.title: Built to run all day
valueProps.body: Commercial equipment, not consumer units, so it survives daily use by a whole floor of staff.

valueProps.title: Booked from an app, checked by your team
valueProps.body: Staff book and start their own sessions. Facilities gets alerts for maintenance and consumables rather than finding out from a complaint.

features.title: Sized to the space you have
features.body: A panel system fits a small room; a sauna and cold room need a dedicated circuit and a finished floor. We’ll tell you what your building needs before you commit.

features.title: Hyperbaric needs supervision
features.body: Chambers are medical devices and need a trained operator, so we steer most workplaces to heat, cold and light instead of selling one in.
